rationale: The agent executed a return on one item using PayPal but did not show evidence of confirming the action with the user before performing the write, which violates the policy. The request was broader—cancel/return all non-gaming items except keyboard and mouse—yet the agent only accessed one order and returned a single item without clarifying which items should be excluded or reviewing all relevant orders. Authentication beyond looking up the user by email is not evident. The lack of confirmation before an order-changing action and the incomplete handling of the user’s stated goal lead to a fail verdict.
